tool: Contacts and matters with custom fields
checked: Created a contact with three cf_key/cf_value rows (one blank key), saw the blank key dropped and the two real pairs stored in custom_fields_json; confirmed they render on /contacts/<id> and come back pre-filled on /contacts/<id>/edit; re-posted with one key changed, one dropped and one added and confirmed the stored dict matched exactly. Repeated on /matters/new: two custom fields stored on the matter and shown on /matters/<id>.

tool: Conflict check across names, files and messages
checked: Put the same name inside an outbound SMS body (/messages/send), inside an uploaded .txt (/documents/upload, extracted_text populated), inside a matter Note and as a MatterParty. POST /conflicts/run with that one name returned four hits at score 100 with correct source labels (message, document 'file contents', note, party 'witness') and correct URLs; outcome stored as unresolved. A misspelled variant (Krzyzewsky) still fuzzy-matched the party at 94. POST /conflicts/<id>/resolve with outcome=waived persisted outcome and notes and showed on /conflicts history.
notes: By design (_score) fuzzy matching is skipped for text longer than 200 characters, so a misspelled name inside a long message or document body will not hit; only an exact substring will. Documented in the code, worth knowing before relying on it.

tool: Calendar with recurrence, per-user calendars, ICS feeds
checked: Created a weekly event starting Mon 2026-10-05 with recurrence_until 2026-10-26. Parsed the October month grid cell by cell: the event appears on days 5, 12, 19 and 26 and nowhere else; the November grid shows zero occurrences in the grid (only the Upcoming sidebar). Created a private event for user 1, a private event for user 2 and a firm-wide event: ?user=mine showed user 1's plus firm-wide and not user 2's; ?user=<u2> showed user 2's plus firm-wide and not user 1's; ?user=all showed both. Firm feed secret equals sha256(SECRET_KEY+'ics')[:24] as the contract states. /calendar/feed/u/1/<secret>.ics contains user 1's private event and the firm-wide one but not user 2's; the reverse for user 2. Wrong secret and a swapped per-user secret both 404. The ICS body is a well-formed VCALENDAR, every line is 75 octets or fewer, and the recurring event carries RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;UNTIL=20261026T235959Z. Both subscribe URLs are printed on /calendar.

tool: Court rules calendaring (generic starter sets)
checked: Two starter sets seed on first view (FRCP 6 rules, TRCP 4 rules). Loaded 2026 US federal holidays (11 rows, observed dates correct). Checked compute_deadline against hand-worked answers: 21 calendar days after 2026-10-02 = 2026-10-23; a result landing on Sat 2026-10-24 rolled to Mon 2026-10-26; TRCP nextmonday from 2026-10-05 = 2026-10-26 and, when it lands on a Monday, moves to the following Monday (2026-11-02); 5 court days from 2026-11-23 skipped the weekend and Thanksgiving to 2026-12-01; direction=before subtracted correctly. Applied the TRCP set with trigger 'Service of citation' on 2026-10-05: one deadline task at 2026-10-26 carrying rule_id, trigger_date, rule_trigger and the generic-rule disclaimer in notes. Re-applying the same trigger date added nothing; a different trigger date added a second task. The task shows in the rule-tasks section of /tasks.
notes: Scope is genuinely limited, matching the 'partial' status in feature_map: two hand-written generic sets, no jurisdiction-specific rule libraries, and nothing fires automatically from matter events. Every generated task carries the 'check the current rule text' disclaimer.

tool: Client portal with magic-link login
checked: POSTed a mixed-case email to /portal/login, read the PortalToken from the DB (30-minute expiry), authenticated at /portal/auth/<token> and landed on /portal. tool: Draft client update email from notes, work, tasks and dates
checked: With app.llm.complete_json monkeypatched, POST /ai/matter/<id>/update-email returned the model's subject and body on the page and sending it emailed the client and stored a Message (channel=email, direction=out, provider_id client-update:...). With complete_json raising LLMUnavailable, the page still rendered, showed a calm notice naming the reason, and fell back to the deterministic template, which correctly assembled recent work, completed tasks, upcoming deadlines and calendar events with real dates and left out fees and invoices. Save-as-draft routed to /intake/drafts.
notes: The non-AI template fallback copies every matter Note verbatim into the client-facing draft, and the app's own AI matter summary feature writes those notes without the [internal] prefix that update_facts() uses to exclude them. So attorney work product saved by /ai/matter/<id>/summary/save, including any fee or hours language in its Open items, lands in the client draft. update_facts' docstring says fees are deliberately left out, and the AI prompt says the same; the template path does not honour that when the note itself carries them. It is a draft a human sends, so the exposure is bounded, but the two paths disagree.
repro: 1. POST /ai/matter/<id>/summary with app.llm.complete_json returning {'summary': 'Client is elderly and may lack capacity; get a doctor letter before signing.', 'open_items': ['Bill 2 unbilled hours', 'Chase the unpaid invoice']}. 2. POST /ai/matter/<id>/summary/save with that summary and those open items (it writes a plain Note, no [internal] prefix). 3. Make app.llm.complete_json raise LLMUnavailable. 4. POST /ai/matter/<id>/update-email. The rendered <textarea name="body"> contains, under 'Since August 6, 2026, we have:', the lines 'AI summary (Sep 5, 2026): Client is elderly and may lack capacity; get a doctor letter before signing.' and 'Open items: - Bill 2 unbilled hours - Chase the unpaid invoice'.

Each answer carried the right drill-down link and row table.

tool: Phone intake API: POST /api/v1/leads creates and scores a lead, idempotent on an external reference
checked: Minted a read,write API token. POST /api/v1/leads with name, phone, email, matter_type, description, call_summary, a structured transcript array and external_id returned 201 with a score and a lead URL; the stored description contained the description, the flattened call summary, the flattened transcript and the [ref: ...] marker. Reposting the same external_id with a different name returned 200 with created=false and the same id, and only one lead exists for that ref. No Authorization header and a bogus token both 401; a read-only-scope token 403 with a clear message; a body with no name 400.

tool: Voice intake agent hook: the after-hours DUI agent posts a finished intake to Coil when COIL_LEADS_URL is set
checked: The Coil half is present and verified: /settings/voice prints COIL_LEADS_URL with the exact /api/v1/leads value for the agent's config, and /api/v1/voice/config returns that endpoint in its endpoints map. The receiving endpoint itself is covered by the Phone intake API row above and passes.

tool: Client case status by phone after caller id plus name verification (stage, next event, next task, balance, last update date)
checked: With the voice line off, every endpoint refused with {ok:false, reason:'voice_disabled'} and 403. With it on but Firm.voice_client_status off, verify refused with reason client_status_off and recorded an unverified VoiceCall. With both on: /api/v1/voice/lookup reported found true/false without revealing anything about the contact; /api/v1/voice/verify with the right caller id and name returned the client's open matter with stage, next_event (title plus a spoken time in the firm timezone), next_task_due, balance_cents and a last_update line. A wrong name on a real number returned name_mismatch, an unknown number returned no_match, and both recorded outcome=unverified. The payload contained no note bodies and nothing belonging to another client.

tool: Attorney voice line: caller id plus PIN, then dictate a note or log time on a matter by number or description
checked: Calling /api/v1/voice/note before any PIN returned reason=pin_required. A wrong PIN returned bad_pin with an attempts_left counter. The correct PIN (typed with punctuation, digits stripped) opened a session and returned the attorney's matters. /api/v1/voice/note with matter_hint 'the Bluebonnet contract case' resolved to M-1002 and stored a Note prefixed '[by phone]' with whitespace collapsed, attributed to the PIN-verified user. /api/v1/voice/time with minutes=22 created a TimeEntry of 24 minutes (6-minute rounding), rate 35000 from the matter, amount 14000, dated today, and read back 0.4 hours. A user_id in the body that did not match the verified PIN returned user_mismatch. An unresolvable matter hint returned no_matter with a 404 rather than guessing. Five wrong PINs from one number locked it with 423.

tool: Outbound reminder calls before calendar events and court dates (python -m app.cli voice_reminders)
checked: With Firm.voice_reminders on and a 3-day window, upcoming_reminders picked up both a calendar event and a court_date task on matters whose client has a phone, each with a per-occurrence detail key and a spoken script. Without Twilio the run reported 'Twilio is not configured; nothing was called or recorded' and placed nothing. With smssvc.configured patched true and place_call stubbed, the run placed both calls with the right numbers and scripts, wrote a VoiceCall (kind=reminder, outcome=reminded) and a Message (channel=voice) for each. A second run placed nothing and reported 2 skipped, so the AuditLog voice_reminded key is doing its job.
notes: The Twilio REST call in place_call is the only untested hop; it needs live credentials. The wrapper's error handling (returning error:<status> and marking the VoiceCall failed) was read but not exercised.

tool: Call log: every voice call with summary, transcript, outcome and links to the lead, contact and matter
checked: POST /api/v1/voice/calls with call_id, kind, outcome, duration, from/to, a summary and a structured transcript, plus lead_id, contact_id and matter_id, created one VoiceCall with the transcript flattened to 'role: text' lines and all three foreign keys resolved. Posting the same call_id again updated the row rather than creating a second one. /voice/<id> showed the transcript and working links to /intake/<lead>, /contacts/<id> and /matters/<id>. /voice lists calls with per-kind counts and the ?kind= filter narrows correctly; the status, memo and reminder calls created earlier in the audit all appear with their outcomes.

tool: Criminal defense: stage board, case facts, charges with attorney-entered ranges, court date chain, speedy-trial check, disposition PDF
checked: Started a case on a matter (stage=arrest). Saved facts: court, cause number, arrest date, bond $2,500 posted, custody, prosecutor, judge, next setting 2026-10-20 as an arraignment, stage=charged. The matter's court and case_number were back-filled from the case. Added two charges with attorney-typed degrees, ranges and max fines and confirmed they stored verbatim. Ran the court date chain once: exactly four tasks at 2026-10-13 (prepare), 2026-10-18 (confirm appearance), 2026-10-20 (the arraignment, kind=court_date, priority high, cause and judge in the notes) and 2026-11-03 (request discovery, arraignment + 14 days). A second run added none. The speedy-trial check created one deadline at arrest + 180 days with the 'confirm the jurisdiction's rule' note, and a second run added none. The disposition PDF generated and filed a 2.2 KB Document in the Criminal folder on the matter. The board lists the case under its stage.
